about: Asks the music test command runs (npm run test-music-asks): each ask with the tracks it should find, best first. Expected tracks are music files by base name (any case) or card ids; a track counts as found when any card that plays it is among the candidates. The first asks are scene needs whose tracks the author picked by ear on a listening sheet. The rest are typical needs whose expected tracks were chosen from the listening notes' words, so they are marked reviewed: false until someone has heard them. Asks never name a map, campaign, character or story. An ask may name tags, which the command pins as the page would: `show: everything` lists the silent, unplayable and map-local ids the page hides by default.

asks.ask: a sharp upward string slide that lands on a hard orchestral attack hit, a short stinger to play under a warning marker just before an enemy strikes
asks.from: picked by ear: stinger for an enemy's arrival

asks.ask: a low, uneasy bed that sits under dialogue at a crime scene, steady and watchful with no big melody, long enough to play under black and fade out
asks.from: picked by ear: bed under a crime-scene cutscene

asks.ask: a short, deep hit that lands when a character decides to go in, an impact that punctuates one line without a melody
asks.from: picked by ear: stinger on a character's decision (its notes call it a sound effect, so the default view hides it)
